svg.title: thanks for stopping by ☂
svg.desc: Footer: the torn bottom edge of a dotted journal page on a lavender icon wallpaper. A dashed flight route with a paper plane links small Shanghai (上海) and San Diego skylines, framing the handwritten words 'thanks for stopping by' and a tiny umbrella; the small cat-eared robot waves from under a clear umbrella in the rain.
